The '''Void Jumpers''' were an elite military unit within the [[Galactic Alliance Marines]]. They saw action alongside the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in [[44 ABY]] during the [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|assault]] on the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]]-occupied [[New Jedi Temple]] in the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberation]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Ones/Legends|entity]] [[Abeloth]].
